classes.name: LeaveListController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the leave list view, setting up necessary data and properties for rendering the leave list component within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the instance of CompanyStructureService used to fetch organizational subunits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary props such as employee info, leave types, dates, statuses, and subunit data, performing access checks and data fetching.

methods.name: addLeaveStatusesProp
methods.description: Adds the predefined leave statuses to the component, translating labels for localization.

methods.name: addLeaveTypeProp
methods.description: Adds the leave type object to the component if leaveTypeId is provided in the request.

methods.name: addLeaveStatusProp
methods.description: Adds the leave status object to the component based on the request parameter.

methods.name: addFromToDateProps
methods.description: Adds fromDate and toDate props to the component if both are present in the request.
